observations.observation: The complete mobile page has one continuous text column, a wrapped English title and breadcrumb, three separated section boundaries, displayed equations, five nonblank figures and a visible ending. No obvious paragraph collisions, figure/body overlap, horizontal truncation or missing-page region is apparent at the supplied whole-page viewing scale. English Figure 153 through Figure 157 captions sit separately below their respective media.

Despite the polarization-viewport filename, these saved pixels show the course opening. The two-line title, English breadcrumb and opening definitions have readable glyphs, comfortable line spacing and clear paragraph separation inside the mobile margins. The bottom line continues beyond the 844px viewport boundary; the whole-page image shows continuing content, so this is a screenshot viewport boundary rather than evidence of container clipping.

Nonblank parallel-connection diagram is fully framed at 358px width. Both plate pairs, wires and node dots are visible. C1/C2 and signed charge-magnitude labels with lower indices are distinguishable, separated from the drawing and not cut off. The Figure 153 caption is separately visible in the whole-page context.

Nonblank series-connection diagram is fully framed. Both plate pairs and the connecting wire remain visible; charge labels, C1/C2 and U1/U2/U3 lower-index labels are legible and separated without obvious collisions or edge clipping. The Figure 154 caption is separately visible in the whole-page context.

Paper-capacitor package examples, the wound-layer spiral and the layered strip all render nonblank and remain within the saved frame. Paper capacitors, Paper, Wound layers, Metal foil and Insulating paper are readable English labels with clear separation from adjacent panels. The Figure 155 caption is separately visible in the whole-page context.

The air-variable capacitor, knob, frame and interleaved plate drawing are nonblank and fully framed. Air-variable capacitor, Fixed plates, Moving plates and Air gaps are readable, separated and not clipped; dense apparatus lines do not obscure these labels. The Figure 156 caption is separately visible in the whole-page context.

External electrolytic-capacitor packages and leads are nonblank and fully framed. Electrolytic capacitors, Axial leads and Mounting stud are readable with separated callouts. The Figure 157 caption and following English prose remain separated; that prose explicitly identifies external packages rather than an internal cutaway. No polarity, voltage rating or internal structure is inferred from these pixels.

limitations: The whole-page tool display was downsampled from 390x12111 to 193x6000 pixels. It supports broad full-course continuity, overlap, framing and caption-placement review, not exhaustive fine-glyph certification of every paragraph, equation, superscript or caption.

Only the prescribed seven saved mobile images were opened, once each. The five figure screenshots and opening viewport supply local readable pixels, but no extra crops, reopens, desktop images, SVGs, original-source images or additional viewport captures were inspected.

Figure-only screenshots do not include the course captions; caption presence and separation were observed in the downsampled whole-page screenshot and corroborated by the bound report, not certified at native caption-glyph resolution.

This is isolated headless offline native-course HTML evidence, not a headed product session, production acceptance, physical-device test or interactive-browser certification. The existing report records the browser closed and zero requests; no browser was launched here.

Restored Chinese machine/ARIA figure labels remain in the bound report while visible body, captions and figure labels are English. This saved-pixel PASS is not complete English accessibility approval, a screen-reader review, an accessibility certification or a claim that ARIA is localized.

Original-source fidelity, scientific correctness and the supplied EN82R1R4 PASS are reused unchanged; this review does not replay or extend those approvals. Figure 157 is reviewed as external packages only, without inferring polarity, ratings or a cutaway.

No new minimum-font-size guarantee is inferred solely from screenshots. Existing mobile DOM label measurements are reused; downsampled full-page fine text remains subject to the stated viewing-resolution limit.
